test_cases.title: Health and readiness endpoints expose safe status
test_cases.description: Verify health is fast and public, readiness reflects repository state, and neither endpoint leaks secrets or stack traces.

steps.description: GET /health
Response is 200 with success true and status ok
GET /ready
Response is 200 with ready/degraded status and store label only

test_cases.title: Fare calculation happy path and response envelope
test_cases.description: Verify a valid future one-way fare returns INR quote, fare version, total, advance, remaining, and deterministic vehicle data.

steps.description: POST a valid sedan Agra-to-Delhi future pickup request
Response is successful and has currency INR, fareVersion, and arithmetic fields
Total equals advance plus remaining and values are non-negative

test_cases.title: Fare engine boundary and invalid input matrix
test_cases.description: Verify missing, unknown, negative, zero, huge, NaN-like, past-date, unsupported-trip, and extra-key requests return validation errors.

steps.description: Submit each invalid fare payload from the fixture matrix
Each response is 400 with VALIDATION_ERROR and requestId
No invalid fare or internal exception is returned

test_cases.title: Fare rules for round trip, night, package, and capacity
test_cases.description: Verify the fare engine applies trip type, night allowance, local package, vehicle tier, and passenger capacity rules consistently.

steps.description: Calculate paired daytime/nighttime and one-way/round-trip quotes
Only the expected configured rule deltas change
Calculate with over-capacity vehicle/passenger pair
Request is rejected or returns an explicit unavailable result

test_cases.title: Location autocomplete contract and fallback provider
test_cases.description: Verify bounded query returns curated suggestions without LocationIQ and handles empty/no-result/provider failures safely.

steps.description: GET autocomplete with q=agra
Response is 200 with suggestion array and safe fields
Try empty, Unicode, oversized, and unknown queries
No stack trace or provider token appears and response remains bounded

test_cases.title: Booking draft creates authoritative fare snapshot
test_cases.description: Verify valid draft creates one booking ticket and stores the server-calculated fare rather than trusting a client total.

steps.description: POST a valid draft using fixture data
Response is 201 with AGR ticket format, booking state, and fare snapshot
Alter any client-provided total and repeat
Server ignores or rejects untrusted amount and calculates its own snapshot

test_cases.title: Booking draft rejects temporal, contact, capacity, and XSS input
test_cases.description: Verify past dates, invalid phone, invalid passenger count, over-capacity vehicle, oversized strings, script notes, and unknown keys are rejected.

steps.description: POST each invalid draft fixture
Response is 400 with safe validation error and requestId
No booking row or side effect is created for rejected input

test_cases.title: Booking voucher verification prevents bypass
test_cases.description: Verify no verification is 401, last-four-only is 400, full phone succeeds, and returned PII is masked.

steps.description: Create a draft and GET its ticket without credentials
Response is 401
GET using only the last four digits
Response is 400 and does not disclose the voucher
GET using the full correct phone
Response is 200 and customer phone/data is masked

test_cases.title: Payment checkout uses persisted booking amount
test_cases.description: Verify checkout requires an existing authorized booking, uses persisted advance, validates provider/currency, and is idempotent.

steps.description: Create a draft and request checkout with valid provider and idempotency key
Checkout response references the booking and persisted amount
Repeat with the same key, altered amount, unknown ticket, and unsupported provider
Duplicate is safe and invalid variants are rejected without a second charge

test_cases.title: Payment webhooks require valid signatures and deduplicate events
test_cases.description: Verify each provider webhook rejects missing/invalid signatures, accepts a correctly signed test event, and treats duplicate event IDs idempotently.

steps.description: POST malformed and unsigned webhook bodies
Responses reject safely without state mutation
POST one correctly signed event twice
First event reconciles and second event is a no-op success or explicit duplicate response

test_cases.title: Inquiry validation, sanitization, and rate limit
test_cases.description: Verify valid inquiry creation, strict schema validation, safe text handling, duplicate behavior, and per-route rate limits.

steps.description: POST a valid inquiry
Response is 201 with safe success envelope
Submit invalid names, phones, email, short/long messages, HTML/script, extra keys, and more than the allowed burst
Invalid requests are 400 and the burst eventually returns 429 with request ID

test_cases.title: Catalog and review public filtering
test_cases.description: Verify published catalog/review endpoints return only intended public records, support valid filters, and reject malformed IDs/statuses.

steps.description: Request list, slug/detail, and filtered public resources
Response shape, pagination, and published visibility are correct
Use invalid UUID, slug, status, page, and pageSize values
Invalid query/path values return safe 400 responses

test_cases.title: Review submission validation and sanitization
test_cases.description: Verify rating, display name, content length, catalog reference, social URL, script payload, and repeated-character spam rules.

steps.description: Submit valid review for catalog slug
Response is successful and text is sanitized
Submit ratings outside 1–5, short/long text, script URL, missing catalog reference, and spam repetition
Every invalid case is rejected with no public review created

test_cases.title: Admin authentication and role authorization
test_cases.description: Verify protected admin list, audit, catalog/review, and refund operations reject anonymous, malformed, expired, and wrong-role tokens.

steps.description: Call protected routes with no token and malformed token
Response is 401 without data leakage
Call role-restricted routes with a valid but insufficient role
Response is 403 and no mutation occurs

test_cases.title: Admin bookings pagination and filters are bounded
test_cases.description: Verify status, ticket, page, and pageSize filters work and invalid/oversized pagination cannot cause unbounded queries.

steps.description: Call admin bookings with each supported status and boundary page values
Results include stable pagination metadata and bounded size
Use page zero, negative values, pageSize above 100, and unknown status
Requests are rejected or normalized according to schema

test_cases.title: Refund requires reason, UUID idempotency, and correct amount
test_cases.description: Verify refund rejects missing/short/unsafe reason, invalid booking UUID, reused idempotency key, and excessive amount; valid refund is one-time.

steps.description: Submit each invalid refund fixture
Each invalid request returns a safe validation/business error
Submit one valid refund and repeat it with the same key
Only one refund state transition occurs

test_cases.title: CORS and security headers enforce browser boundary
test_cases.description: Verify configured customer/admin origins are allowed, unknown origins are rejected, preflight works, and security headers are present.

steps.description: Send requests with allowed, unknown, and absent Origin headers
CORS behavior matches production policy and preflight lists only allowed methods/headers
Helmet headers are present and permissive unsafe headers are absent

test_cases.title: Payload limits, malformed JSON, methods, and rate limits
test_cases.description: Verify oversized body, malformed JSON, unsupported methods, and repeated requests fail predictably with no process crash.

steps.description: Send malformed JSON, body above 1 MB, unsupported method, and rate-limit burst
Responses are controlled 4xx/413/429 with error envelope and request ID
The API remains available for a subsequent health request

test_cases.title: Error responses redact secrets and internal details
test_cases.description: Verify provider, database, authorization, and validation errors never include credentials, connection strings, stack traces, or raw payment payloads.

steps.description: Trigger representative downstream and validation failures
Messages are actionable but generic enough to avoid secret leakage
Request IDs are present for correlation

test_cases.title: Concurrent duplicate writes preserve state integrity
test_cases.description: Verify concurrent identical draft, checkout, webhook, and refund operations do not create duplicate money or booking state transitions.

steps.description: Issue concurrent requests with the same idempotency/event keys in a disposable environment
At most one authoritative mutation occurs and all responses are consistent
Final booking/payment/refund state is valid according to the state machine
